conformance.note: Pinned cut creation is implemented in `harness/src/cut.ts`.
Gondolin builder confinement is implemented in `harness/src/builder-room.ts`; supported target stacks select distinct offline rooms and unknown stacks fail closed.
Deterministic unapproved selection identity is implemented by `selection_registry.clj`.
Approval binds the selection identity and digest.
Approved selection retrieval is supported by the durable entrypoint.
Request idempotency is held in worker memory and is lost on restart.
The builder uses a fresh persisted Pi session, returns its distinct session identity in the builder result, and requires tool output.
Compose structure, lifecycle, and supported-stack conformance checks are implemented.
Verification output is captured by the cycle workflow; failed verification can drive a maximum-three-attempt repair loop through read-only evidence pointers.
Binary item observations reduce into a cycle measurement.
The grade gate preserves a valid poor score as workflow output.
Observation and measurement schemas retain evidence identities and digests.
Measurement reduction retains the complete supplied denominator.
Host cannot pass independent grading, and the terminal result does not preserve the modeled explicit limitation.
Full source-commit validation occurs after a cut task receipt is created.
Selection validation reads the legacy plan feature, not the complete project model.
Candidate-scope validation occurs during builder-room creation after submission.
Repeated waits are stable only for the lifetime of the current worker.
Unknown numeric task identities are rejected.

`start-cycle` plus `execution-status` reconstructs overall state from ORC's durable tick projection and startup resumes abandoned ORC frontiers; legacy numeric `submit`/`wait` receipts and futures remain process-local.
Missing or non-vector GEPA example collections are refused.

GEPA scoring is gated by full harness calibration, requires an approved selection, runs a fresh digest-identified candidate, validates the product oracle and Compose contract, and scores the complete independent per-item measurement.
A winner is independently selected, but activation remains only in worker memory and metric evidence is not yet sealed into a harness evidence manifest.

ORC runs `cut → harness-calibration → builder → instrument → oracle → affordance-conformance → verify → repair-verification → graders → instrument-conformance → record-cycle → grade-gate`; affordance conformance is capability-based, renderer-neutral, and non-applicable for slices not selected by the contract, calibration must pass before candidate construction, repair is limited to three verification attempts, and grading cannot start until the effective final verification passes.
Instrumentation rechecks the builder digest and binds a sibling evidence root without modifying the candidate.

Product-oracle OCI validation exists, but the sharpened contract still needs E2E proof that commit, fenced tree, exact denominator, and instrument-oracle descriptor are verified before builder startup; mutable tags must never become authority.
Removed from the denominator; read-only mounts and before/after subject-digest preservation are exercised by active `01-042`.
Observation validation preserves evidence provenance.
Raw evidence is sealed into the persisted cycle measurement before Allure is derived; report loss cannot change the recorded verdict.
Non-success outcomes collapse, and failed stages do not persist a complete denominator measurement.
Runtime conformance is persisted under a distinct independent producer, but the observation schema does not yet encode the full candidate/observer/grader authority model.
The model now requires missing, incomplete, sampled, or dropped signals to persist `inconclusive` with affected kind and reason, but the E2E fault cases remain skipped.

A generic, domain-free evaluator loads the selected project's runtime-evidence contract from the pinned cut, validates declared record cardinality, values, correlations, and `fields-equal` invariants, and emits a separate observation for every contracted selected item. Before persistence, every observation is enriched with all sealed input-artifact digests. Löyly has live runtime-evidence contracts for `@item-01-007` and `@item-01-008`; all eleven selected items are independently black-box graded.

After Grain returns the persisted invariant observation, the harness derives both an Allure result and an OTLP JSON result span carrying the same deterministic evaluation identity, verdict, and sealed evidence-manifest digest; neither projection can author or alter the verdict.
Approval binds only the selection digest; scope, target stack, execution profile, pinned inputs, diagram, and outer-cycle budget are not one approved preparation.

The JSON control boundary exposes ORC `start-cycle` with caller-supplied durable identities and survives client disconnects, but no complete session-agnostic preparation contract or parent-cycle lineage exists.

The RPC reconciles authoritative ORC tick status with durable stage, attempt, and builder-session projections, and startup resumes abandoned ORC frontiers. Push notification subscription and automatic live rendering remain unimplemented.

Each build attempt persists an append-only Pi transcript and a read-only RPC exposes committed turns, tool-call count, generated top-level entries, status, and progress. The E2E verifies observation does not alter transcript or candidate fixture content.
There is no explicit pause, steer, or fork protocol and no assisted-candidate provenance marker.
Pi transcripts and VM-visible workspace generations are not durably bound; only completed generated output is persisted.
A Pi operator session does not yet drive exploratory profiling inside Gondolin as a modeled, provenance-recorded operation.

The active Gondolin E2E verifies read-only candidate and capture-policy mounts, the sole writable cycle evidence volume, before/after subject digest equality, the baked OBI/OTel eBPF toolchain, tracefs/BPF FS, and diagnostic-only OTLP policy.

surfaces.name: RegenerationExecutionPipeline
surfaces.source:
surface RegenerationExecutionPipeline {
    provides:
        ApprovedCycleStarted(cycle)
        PinnedCutValidated(cycle, cut_digest)
        FullHarnessCalibrated(cycle, harness_snapshot_digest, harness_source_digest, fixture_identities)
        FreshBuilderCompleted(cycle, builder_session_identity, operation_identity,
                              workspace_generation, assisted, subject_digest,
                              generated_paths, tool_calls)
        CandidateInstrumented(cycle, subject_digest, evidence_locations,
                              runtime_signal_identities, collection_complete)
        IndependentAffordanceConformanceReturned(cycle, producer, passed, applicable,
                                                 total, passed_count, evidence)
        ApplicationContractVerificationReturned(cycle, subject_digest, target_stack,
                                                passed, evidence_root)
        VerificationRepairBuilderCompleted(cycle, attempt, builder_session_identity,
                                           operation_identity, workspace_generation, assisted)
        VerificationRepairCompleted(cycle, attempts, final_subject_digest)
        IndependentProductEvidenceCollected(cycle, evidence_items)
        IndependentOracleComparisonReturned(cycle, observations)
        IndependentInstrumentConformanceReturned(cycle, observations, passed)
        ReducePipelineMeasurement(cycle)
        DerivePipelineResult(cycle)

    @guarantee ExactStageOrder
        -- ORC alone advances cut, harness calibration, builder, instrument, verify, evidence
        -- collection, oracle comparison, instrument conformance, record cycle, and result.

    @guarantee ReadOnlyIndependentObservation
        -- Verification and grading observe the instrumented candidate without modifying it.

    @guarantee ExplicitNonSuccess
        -- Refusal, skip, timeout, and error identify their stage and preserve every approved denominator item.
}

entities.name: PipelineCycle
entities.source:
entity PipelineCycle {
    identity: String
    selection_identity: String
    approved_items: List<String>
    stage: PipelineStage
    status: PipelineStatus
    failure_stage: PipelineStage?
    failure_kind: StageFailureKind?
    failure_reason: String?

    transitions stage {
        cut -> harness_calibration
        harness_calibration -> builder
        builder -> instrument
        instrument -> affordance_conformance
        affordance_conformance -> verify
        verify -> repair_verification
        repair_verification -> collect_evidence
        collect_evidence -> compare_oracle
        compare_oracle -> instrument_conformance
        instrument_conformance -> record_cycle
        record_cycle -> result
        terminal: result
    }

    transitions status {
        submitted -> running
        running -> passed
        running -> failed
        terminal: passed, failed
    }
}

rules.name: StartPipeline
rules.source:
rule StartPipeline {

    ensures: cycle.stage = cut
}

rules.name: ValidatePipelineCut
rules.source:
rule ValidatePipelineCut {
    when: PinnedCutValidated(cycle, cut_digest)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = cut
    requires: complete_model_contract_resolved_once(cycle.selection_identity, cut_digest)
    ensures: cycle.stage = harness_calibration
}

rules.name: CalibratePipelineHarness
rules.source:
rule CalibratePipelineHarness {
    when: FullHarnessCalibrated(cycle, harness_snapshot_digest,
                                harness_source_digest, fixture_identities)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = harness_calibration
    requires: fresh_harness_snapshot_sealed(cycle, harness_snapshot_digest)
    requires: complete_harness_snapshot_component_coverage(cycle, harness_snapshot_digest)
    requires: product_oracle_resolved_by_descriptor_digest(cycle)
    requires: product_oracle_contains_selected_items_exactly_once(cycle)
    requires: selected_item_scenario_digests_match_product_oracle(cycle)
    requires: selected_product_oracle_entries_have_approved_expected_evidence(cycle)
    requires: evidence_collector_and_comparator_are_calibrated(cycle)
    requires: harness_source_digest = discovered_harness_source_digest(cycle)
    requires: carried_and_uncarried_goldens_passed(cycle, fixture_identities)
    ensures: HarnessCalibration.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        harness_snapshot_digest: harness_snapshot_digest,
        harness_source_digest: harness_source_digest,
        passed: true,
        fixture_identities: fixture_identities
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = builder
}

rules.name: BuildPipelineCandidate
rules.source:
rule BuildPipelineCandidate {
    when: FreshBuilderCompleted(cycle, builder_session_identity, operation_identity,
                                workspace_generation, assisted, subject_digest,
                                generated_paths, tool_calls)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = builder
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    requires: tool_calls > 0
    ensures: PipelineBuilderSession.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        identity: builder_session_identity,
        operation_identity: operation_identity,
        attempt: 1,
        workspace_generation: workspace_generation,
        assisted: assisted
    )
    ensures: CandidateSubject.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        digest: subject_digest,
        generated_paths: generated_paths,
        tool_calls: tool_calls
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = instrument
}

rules.name: InstrumentPipelineCandidate
rules.source:
rule InstrumentPipelineCandidate {
    when: CandidateInstrumented(cycle, subject_digest, evidence_locations,
                                runtime_signal_identities, collection_complete)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = instrument
    requires: exists CandidateSubject{cycle: cycle, digest: subject_digest}
    requires: digest_after_instrumentation(cycle) = subject_digest
    ensures: InstrumentationRecord.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        subject_digest: subject_digest,
        evidence_locations: evidence_locations,
        runtime_signal_identities: runtime_signal_identities,
        collection_complete: collection_complete
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = affordance_conformance
}

rules.name: EvaluateCandidateAffordances
rules.source:
rule EvaluateCandidateAffordances {
    when: IndependentAffordanceConformanceReturned(cycle, producer, passed, applicable,
                                                    total, passed_count, evidence)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = affordance_conformance
    requires: applicable implies total > 0
    requires: not applicable implies (passed and total = 0)
    requires: passed_count >= 0
    requires: passed_count <= total
    requires: passed implies passed_count = total
    ensures: AffordanceConformanceEvaluation.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        producer: producer,
        passed: passed,
        applicable: applicable,
        total: total,
        passed_count: passed_count,
        evidence: evidence
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = verify
}

rules.name: RecordInitialVerification
rules.source:
rule RecordInitialVerification {
    when: ApplicationContractVerificationReturned(cycle, subject_digest, target_stack,
                                                   passed, evidence_root)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = verify
    requires: exists InstrumentationRecord{cycle: cycle, subject_digest: subject_digest}
    requires: candidate_mounted_read_only(cycle)
    requires: target_stack = independently_detected_supported_stack(cycle, subject_digest)
    ensures: VerificationAttempt.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        round: 1,
        subject_digest: subject_digest,
        target_stack: target_stack,
        passed: passed,
        evidence_root: evidence_root
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = repair_verification
}

rules.name: RecordRepairBuilderSession
rules.source:
rule RecordRepairBuilderSession {
    when: VerificationRepairBuilderCompleted(cycle, attempt, builder_session_identity,
                                             operation_identity, workspace_generation,
                                             assisted)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = repair_verification
    requires: attempt >= 2
    requires: attempt <= 3
    requires: not exists PipelineBuilderSession{operation_identity: operation_identity}
    ensures: PipelineBuilderSession.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        identity: builder_session_identity,
        operation_identity: operation_identity,
        attempt: attempt,
        workspace_generation: workspace_generation,
        assisted: assisted
    )
}

rules.name: CompleteVerificationRepair
rules.source:
rule CompleteVerificationRepair {
    when: VerificationRepairCompleted(cycle, attempts, final_subject_digest)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = repair_verification
    requires: attempts.count >= 1
    requires: attempts.count <= 3
    requires: attempts.last.passed
    requires: attempts.last.subject_digest = final_subject_digest
    requires: attempts.all(a => a.target_stack = independently_detected_supported_stack(
        cycle, a.subject_digest
    ))
    requires: every_failed_attempt_seeds_next_candidate(attempts)
    requires: every_failed_attempt_evidence_is_read_only_to_next_builder(attempts)
    requires: grade_and_oracle_evidence_hidden_from_every_builder(attempts)
    requires: every_repair_attempt_has_builder_session(attempts)
    requires: exists InstrumentationRecord{
        cycle: cycle,
        subject_digest: final_subject_digest
    }
    ensures: cycle.stage = collect_evidence
}

rules.name: CollectPipelineProductEvidence
rules.source:
rule CollectPipelineProductEvidence {
    when: IndependentProductEvidenceCollected(cycle, evidence_items)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = collect_evidence
    requires: evidence_items.count > 0
    requires: evidence_items.all(e => e.item_identity in cycle.approved_items)
    requires: evidence_items.all(e => e.subject_digest = instrumented_subject_digest(cycle))
    ensures:
        for item in evidence_items:
            CollectedProductEvidence.created(
                cycle: cycle,
                item_identity: item.item_identity,
                producer: item.producer,
                evidence: item.evidence,
                evidence_digest: item.evidence_digest,
                cut_digest: item.cut_digest,
                subject_digest: item.subject_digest
            )
    ensures: cycle.stage = compare_oracle
}

rules.name: ComparePipelineEvidenceWithOracle
rules.source:
rule ComparePipelineEvidenceWithOracle {
    when: IndependentOracleComparisonReturned(cycle, observations)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = compare_oracle
    requires: observations.count > 0
    requires: observations.all(o => o.item_identity in cycle.approved_items)
    requires: observations.all(o => o.subject_digest = instrumented_subject_digest(cycle))
    requires: observations.all(o => o.oracle_digest = combined_oracle_digest(
        harness_snapshot_digest(cycle),
        resolved_product_oracle_descriptor_digest(cycle)
    ))
    ensures:
        for observation in observations:
            PipelineObservation.created(
                cycle: cycle,
                item_identity: observation.item_identity,
                producer: observation.producer,
                authority: observation.authority,
                evidence_purpose: observation.evidence_purpose,
                verdict: observation.verdict,
                reached: observation.reached,
                evidence: observation.evidence,
                cut_digest: observation.cut_digest,
                subject_digest: observation.subject_digest,
                oracle_digest: observation.oracle_digest
            )
    ensures: cycle.stage = instrument_conformance
}

rules.name: EvaluatePipelineInstrumentConformance
rules.source:
rule EvaluatePipelineInstrumentConformance {
    when: IndependentInstrumentConformanceReturned(cycle, observations, passed)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = instrument_conformance
    requires: observations.count > 0
    requires: observations.all(o => o.item_identity in cycle.approved_items)
    requires: observations.all(o => o.subject_digest = instrumented_subject_digest(cycle))
    ensures: InstrumentConformanceEvaluation.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        producer: "runtime-instrument-conformance",
        passed: passed,
        item_results: observations
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = record_cycle
}

rules.name: RecordPipelineMeasurement
rules.source:
rule RecordPipelineMeasurement {
    when: ReducePipelineMeasurement(cycle)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = record_cycle
    let reached = PipelineObservations where cycle = cycle and reached
    let passed_items = reached where verdict = pass
    let total = cycle.approved_items.count
    ensures: PipelineMeasurement.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        total: total,
        passed: passed_items.count,
        failed: total - passed_items.count,
        complete: reached.count = total,
        item_results: results_for_every_approved_item(cycle, reached)
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = result
}

rules.name: PassPipelineCycle
rules.source:
rule PassPipelineCycle {
    when: DerivePipelineResult(cycle)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = result
    requires: cycle_measurement(cycle).complete
    requires: cycle_measurement(cycle).failed = 0
    requires: instrument_conformance(cycle).passed
    requires: latest_affordance_conformance(cycle).passed
    ensures: cycle.status = passed
}

rules.name: FailPipelineStage
rules.source:
rule FailPipelineStage {
    when: PipelineStageDidNotSucceed(cycle, stage, failure_kind, reason)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = stage
    ensures: cycle.status = failed
    ensures: cycle.failure_stage = stage
    ensures: cycle.failure_kind = failure_kind
    ensures: cycle.failure_reason = reason
    ensures: FailedDenominatorPreserved(cycle: cycle, item_identities: cycle.approved_items)
}

    requires: generation.approved_items.count > 0
    requires: generation.workspace_scope.count > 0

    requires: source_cut_excludes_prior_implementation_and_measurements(generation.source_cut)

rule ProposeOracleFromSuccessfulGrade {
    when: FreshSliceGenerationGradeCompleted(generation, grade, scenario_digests)
    requires: generation.status = running
    requires: grade.generation = generation
    requires: grade.cycle_oracle_binding_digest =
              sealed_cycle_oracle_for(generation).binding_digest
    requires: grade.subject_digest != ""
    requires: grade.judge_identity != ""
    requires: grade.complete
    requires: grade.passed
    requires: grade.instrument_conformance_passed
    requires: grade.item_verdicts.count = generation.approved_items.count
    requires: every_approved_item_has_one_pass_with_evidence(
        generation.approved_items, grade.item_verdicts)

surface RegenerationControlPlane {
    facing operator_session: OperatorSession

    provides:
        PrepareRegenerationCut(operator_session, request_identity, request_digest, source_commit, backend)
        ProposeSliceSelection(operator_session, cut_identity, operator_intent)
        PreviewSliceSelection(operator_session, cut_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
        ApproveSliceSelection(operator_session, selection, supplied_digest)
        PrepareRegenerationCycle(operator_session, preparation_identity, selection,
                                 candidate_scope, target_stack, execution_profile,
                                 cut_digest, oracle_digest, diagram_digest, max_outer_cycles)
        ApprovePreparedCycle(operator_session, preparation, supplied_digest)
        ApproveOracleProposal(operator_session, proposal, supplied_digest)
        SubmitRegenerationCycle(operator_session, request_identity, request_digest,
                                preparation, parent_cycle_identity)
        WaitRegenerationTask(operator_session, task)
        QueryCycleProgress(operator_session, cycle_identity)
        ReadCycleMeasurement(operator_session, cycle_identity)
        OpenBuilderSession(operator_session, builder_session)
        InterveneBuilderSession(operator_session, builder_session, intervention_kind)
        PrepareChildCycle(operator_session, parent_task, child_preparation, reason)

    @guarantee DurableTaskObservation
        -- A replacement worker reconstructs a known task outcome from ORC state and never reruns it to answer a wait.

    @guarantee RefusalBeforeExecution
        -- Invalid identities, selections, scopes, and backends are refused before builder work begins.

    @guarantee SessionAgnosticControl
        -- ORC cycle state outlives the Codex, Pi, or other operator session that requested it.

    @guarantee ExploratorySessionOwnership
        -- Skills, dynamic tools, branching, and human steering remain in the operator session.

    @guarantee ImmutableHandoff
        -- Only the approved preparation crosses into ORC; the exploratory transcript never becomes builder input.

    @guarantee FixedContractOwnership
        -- ORC owns bounded prompt execution, constrained tools, retries, termination, grading, and measurement.

    @guarantee ObservableNotAuthoritative
        -- Live notifications and builder-session views aid operators but never advance ORC state.
}

                                 oracle_digest, diagram_digest, max_outer_cycles)
        ApproveCyclePreparation(operator, preparation, digest)
        SubmitRegenerationCycle(operator, request_identity, preparation, parent_cycle_identity)
        ObserveBuilderSession(operator, builder_session)

    @guarantee BuilderIsolation
        -- The builder reads a fenced cut, writes only the declared scope, and does not inherit the operator transcript.

    @guarantee CalibratedBuilder
        -- No builder starts until a fresh harness snapshot covers the complete committed harness,
        -- binds every runtime asset, and passes carried and uncarried normalized Allure goldens;
        -- independently, the product oracle supplies digest-matched approved expected evidence per item.

    @guarantee IndependentMeasurement
        -- The builder cannot author the oracle, verifier, evidence collector, comparator, or final measurement used to pass its cycle.

    @guarantee InconclusiveDoesNotPass
        -- Missing or incomplete required runtime evidence remains in the denominator
        -- and cannot be interpreted as a passing item.

    @guarantee HonestDenominator
        -- Missing or unreached items fail and remain in the approved denominator.
}

scenarios.rule: ORC owns the complete ordered execution pipeline
steps: Given an approved cycle starts
When ORC advances the cycle

Then its stages are cut, harness calibration, builder, instrument, affordance conformance, verify, repair verification, collect evidence, compare oracle, instrument conformance, record cycle, and grade gate in that order
And adapter completion cannot reorder or skip an ORC stage
And before the builder starts ORC verifies the fresh sealed harness snapshot
And every verdict-affecting harness component, runtime asset, and the complete harness revision match its manifest
And normalized carried and uncarried Allure goldens pass
And any calibration mismatch prevents the builder stage

And Grade builds, calibrates, and seals a fresh candidate-blind cycle oracle before black-box evaluation
And the builder receives no parent candidate, grader evidence, or host credentials
And writes remain confined to the approved workspace scope

steps: Given a Fresh Slice Generation Cycle is running for an approved selection

And ORC calibrates the cycle oracle against carried and uncarried behavior and seals its binding digest

When the operator runs make -C harness bootstrap
Then npm dependencies are installed in .pi/harness
And Docker builds TypeScript, Rust, Java, Rails, cut, instrument, and grader images
And Gondolin builds the corresponding runtime assets under .pi/harness/.state/assets
And every generated runtime asset is verified
And bootstrap records one manifest binding the harness revision, runtime assets, calibration fixtures, and generic conformance machinery
And carried and uncarried harness calibration passes before that manifest is sealed
And no oracle reference or regeneration state is changed
scenarios.title: make bootstrap builds every harness and supported-stack runtime

scenarios.rule: Harness bootstrap does not build or grade the product
steps: Given the operator runs make -C harness bootstrap
When bootstrap completes
Then it has not built or modified the Löyly implementation
And it has not authored a cycle oracle or resolved or published a product oracle
And it has not submitted a regeneration cycle
scenarios.title: make bootstrap does not run Löyly application or oracle workflows

scenarios.rule: Bootstrap failure is surfaced to the operator
steps: Given Docker or Gondolin cannot build or verify a configured runtime
When the operator runs make -C harness bootstrap
Then make exits unsuccessfully with the failing command visible
And no successful bootstrap is reported
scenarios.title: An invalid runtime build fails the Makefile target

scenarios.rule: The Pi harness is a strictly validated Grain service area inside ORC
steps: Given ORC and the Pi harness have loaded their registered Grain service areas
When the shared Grain runtime starts the Pi harness
Then strict validation reconciles every harness command, event, read model, query, processor, schema, and edge
And missing, extra, or mismatched runtime blocks prevent startup
And CI also resolves every required Grain-to-Allium trace link
scenarios.title: Startup refuses a harness topology that differs from its Grain Event Model

scenarios.rule: The Pi harness is a strictly validated Grain service area inside ORC
steps: Given the Pi harness is running inside ORC's tenant-scoped Grain runtime
When an operator changes or reads harness state
Then every state change passes through a registered Grain command and event
And every public read passes through a registered Grain query over a read model
And no public operation appends a bare event or reads the event store directly
scenarios.title: Public harness operations use Grain commands and queries

scenarios.rule: The Pi harness is a strictly validated Grain service area inside ORC
steps: Given an approved cycle is executing through ORC
When ORC records tree and node execution events
Then the harness progress read model projects the current stage and builder-session reference
And reconnecting clients read that projection through a Grain query
And the harness emits no duplicate progress event
scenarios.title: Harness progress is projected from authoritative ORC events

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given an operator describes the behavior to regenerate against a prepared cut
When an exploratory Pi, Codex, or other operator session inspects the cut composition and asks the LLM to propose a slice
Then every proposed slice and item identity is resolved from that cut
And invented, missing, duplicate, or ambiguous identities are refused
And the resolved selection is recorded as awaiting approval
And a durable session may retain its transcript, skills, tool calls, and branches
But that transcript is not part of the approved execution contract
And no generation or regeneration starts until the operator approves its exact digest
scenarios.title: An LLM proposes a reviewable slice but cannot approve it

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given a cut request does not name a full source commit or supported backend
When the operator prepares the source cut
Then the request is refused before a cut task starts
And an existing cut identity is never replaced by different content
scenarios.title: Cut preparation refuses an invalid or colliding identity

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given the requested slice has missing, duplicate, unstamped, or unknown items
When the operator previews the selection
Then no selection contract is recorded
And the refusal identifies the unresolved denominator
scenarios.title: Selection preview refuses an empty or ambiguous denominator

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given an approved selection
When submission names an empty, absolute, escaping, or overlapping candidate scope
Then submission is refused before a builder room opens
scenarios.title: Submission refuses an unsafe candidate scope

scenarios.rule: Workflow tasks have observable terminal outcomes
steps: Given a source-cut, generation, or regeneration task receipt was returned
When the operator waits for its task identity
Then the result is completed or failed with the ORC trace summary
And waiting again returns the same terminal outcome
scenarios.title: Waiting for a known task returns its one terminal outcome

scenarios.rule: Workflow tasks have observable terminal outcomes
steps: Given no task receipt has the supplied identity
When the operator waits for that identity
Then the request is refused without starting new work
scenarios.title: Waiting refuses an unknown task identity

scenarios.rule: Workflow tasks have observable terminal outcomes
steps: Given an ORC task receipt was returned before the worker stopped
When a replacement worker waits for the task identity
Then it reconstructs the task outcome from durable ORC state
And it does not rerun the task to manufacture an answer
scenarios.title: A durable task remains observable after worker restart

scenarios.rule: The reviewed preparation binds every cycle-defining choice
steps: Given an approved slice selection
When an operator session prepares a cycle with scope, target stack, execution profile, pinned inputs, and outer-cycle budget
Then the harness returns a deterministic preparation diagram and digest
And approval accepts only that exact preparation digest
And changing any bound field requires a new preparation
scenarios.title: Approval binds the complete cycle preparation and diagram

scenarios.rule: The reviewed preparation binds every cycle-defining choice
steps: Given a complete passing first grade produced an oracle proposal awaiting approval
When an operator manually approves its exact proposal digest
Then the control plane requests immutable publication of that proposal
And a stale or different digest is refused
And no accepted product oracle exists before publication succeeds
scenarios.title: Oracle promotion requires manual approval of the exact proposal digest

scenarios.rule: Any operator session can drive the outer lifecycle
steps: Given a Codex, Pi, or other authorized operator session
When it supplies an immutable approved fixed execution contract through the public control plane
Then ORC starts the same regeneration cycle contract
And ORC owns its bounded prompt, tool surface, retries, termination, and result
And disconnecting that session does not stop the internal ORC cycle
scenarios.title: The control plane does not depend on one interactive session implementation

scenarios.rule: Any operator session can drive the outer lifecycle
steps: Given a cycle is running and ORC emits stage notifications
When the observing extension connects or reconnects
Then it displays the current stage and associated builder-session reference
And it queries ORC execution state to recover from missing notifications
And the progress view never becomes workflow authority
scenarios.title: Live progress reconciles with durable ORC execution state

scenarios.rule: Builder sessions are observable without weakening independence
steps: Given ORC opened a separately identified builder session for one build attempt
When an operator session opens that builder-session reference
Then it can inspect committed model turns, tool calls, workspace generation, and progress
But observation cannot change the builder transcript or candidate
And the builder cannot read the operator transcript or independent grader evidence
scenarios.title: An operator observes a builder session read-only

scenarios.rule: Builder sessions are observable without weakening independence
steps: Given a builder session is active or completed
When an operator pauses, steers, or forks its work
Then the action occurs only at a safe boundary or in a distinct fork
And the resulting candidate is marked as assisted
And a completed builder session is never silently mutated
scenarios.title: Intervention is explicit and provenance-recorded

scenarios.rule: Builder sessions are observable without weakening independence
steps: Given a builder session committed model turns and VM tool results
When its host or execution room restarts
Then the session resumes from the workspace generation bound to those committed results
And an uncommitted VM mutation is discarded or replayed from the previous generation
And transcript state is never restored against a mismatched workspace
scenarios.title: A builder transcript is restored with its matching workspace generation

scenarios.rule: A selected project resolves its own VM and target-stack build files by convention
steps: Given the selected project is loyly
When the harness resolves its project runtime files
Then its Gondolin VM config is harness/loyly/gondolin.json
And its TypeScript, Rust, Java, and Rails Dockerfiles are harness/loyly/Dockerfile.<stack>
And each selected target stack uses only its own Dockerfile
scenarios.title: Löyly resolves its Gondolin config and Dockerfile for each supported stack

scenarios.rule: Missing project runtime config fails closed
steps: Given the selected project has no Dockerfile for the requested target stack
When the harness resolves its project runtime files
Then resolution fails before a Gondolin VM starts
And no other project's Dockerfile is substituted
scenarios.title: An unsupported or missing project stack Dockerfile is refused

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given either example set is missing or not a collection
When the operator requests builder-prompt optimization
Then optimization is refused before an instruction candidate is evaluated
scenarios.title: Prompt optimization requires training and validation examples

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given valid training and validation examples
When ORC evaluates an instruction candidate
Then a fresh builder produces a candidate application
And independent verification and a complete candidate-blind black-box grade produce its metric
And the metric does not require a pre-existing accepted product oracle
And the builder cannot supply or alter that metric
scenarios.title: Every instruction candidate is scored by independent regeneration gates

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given prompt optimization evaluated one or more instruction candidates for one purpose
When optimization completes
Then the result identifies the winning instruction and its independent score
And ORC durably deactivates the prior instruction for that purpose
And subsequent cycles recover the selected instruction after process restart
scenarios.title: Only the winning instruction for each purpose becomes durably active

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given ORC owns a complete model-directed strategy and deterministic runtime task context
When an instruction candidate is evaluated
Then ORC renders the exact candidate strategy beside the runtime task context
And the evaluated prompt digest equals the prompt digest received by the builder
And adapter code neither appends instructions nor constructs production prompt text
scenarios.title: GEPA optimizes the complete strategy sent through one prompt seam

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given fresh generation and verification repair use different builder purposes
When ORC measures instruction candidates for each purpose
Then the generation candidate is measured from a fresh approved cut
And the repair candidate is measured from fixed failed-verification inputs
And behavior supplied by one purpose cannot improve the other purpose's score
scenarios.title: Generation and verification repair are independent optimization targets

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given the operator selects an enabled Bedrock reflection model
When GEPA proposes an instruction candidate
Then the optimization binds the Bedrock provider and exact model identity
And the proposal records sanitized model-call and usage evidence
And AWS credentials do not enter prompts, events, transcripts, or repository state
scenarios.title: Bedrock reflection is pinned and provenance recorded

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given a fresh-generation builder, verification-repair builder, or cycle-oracle grader author starts
When its model session is created
Then ORC supplies both the system instruction and task instruction
And ORC binds their digests to the deterministic runtime context and rendered prompt
And TypeScript transports the prompt without constructing or appending production text
scenarios.title: ORC owns every builder and grader-author production prompt

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given a production prompt describes the candidate and execution boundaries
When the model ignores or contradicts one of those boundaries
Then execution rooms still enforce filesystem, network, and credential isolation
And verification still enforces stack, Compose, health, tests, affordances, and evidence
And prompt text cannot weaken an independent gate
scenarios.title: Harness enforcement does not depend on model compliance

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given GEPA uses the pinned Bedrock reflection model
When Bedrock proposes a builder-instruction candidate
Then a fresh fenced Pi/Codex builder executes that instruction
And Bedrock receives no candidate workspace or builder credentials
And the independent grader remains outside both model roles
scenarios.title: Bedrock reflection and candidate execution remain separate roles

scenarios.rule: The neutral source cut is pinned and physically fenced
steps: Given the operator names a full source commit and an execution backend
When the Pi harness prepares the source cut
Then the prepared cut is rooted at exactly that source commit
And its fenced tree identity is recorded
And prior implementation and measurement paths are absent from the reachable cut history
scenarios.title: Preparing a cut returns immutable commit and tree identities

scenarios.rule: The neutral source cut is pinned and physically fenced
steps: Given a prepared cut and a declared candidate scope
When a builder session is opened in Gondolin
Then the cut is mounted read-only
And writes outside the declared candidate scope are denied
And network access, judge material, host credentials, and host session resources are unavailable
scenarios.title: The builder cannot modify or escape the cut

scenarios.rule: The neutral source cut is pinned and physically fenced
steps: Given a prepared cut contains Gherkin behavior items grouped into slices, components, and containers
When the harness maps each item and reduces those mappings into a system view
Then every behavior item appears exactly once in the reconstructed hierarchy
And decomposing that hierarchy reproduces the same slice mappings
And any missing, duplicate, or conflicting mapping makes the composition invalid
scenarios.title: Slice mappings reconstruct the complete cut-bound system view

scenarios.rule: Selection is deterministic and approval binds the reviewed identity
steps: Given the same pinned cut, project, slice, and requested item subset
And the selection has not already been approved
When the selection is previewed more than once
Then each preview contains the same ordered item denominator
And each preview has the same selection identity and digest
And its status is awaiting approval
scenarios.title: Previewing the same slice produces the same selection identity

scenarios.rule: Selection is deterministic and approval binds the reviewed identity
steps: Given a selection contract is awaiting approval
When approval names its selection identity with a different digest
Then approval is refused
And the selection remains awaiting approval
scenarios.title: Approval refuses a digest other than the reviewed digest

scenarios.rule: Cycle submission is approved, scoped, and idempotent
steps: Given a recorded selection has not been approved
When the operator submits a regeneration cycle for that selection
Then submission is refused before a builder starts
scenarios.title: An unapproved selection cannot start a regeneration cycle

scenarios.rule: Cycle submission is approved, scoped, and idempotent
steps: Given a regeneration request has already been submitted
When the identical request is submitted with the same request identity
Then the original cycle and task receipt is returned
But reusing that request identity with a different payload is refused
scenarios.title: Repeating the same request identity returns the original receipt

scenarios.rule: The builder produces a new candidate from the pinned contract
steps: Given an approved selection and a prepared cut
When the builder stage runs
Then it uses a fresh separately identified builder session without the operator transcript
And it receives the ORC-selected instruction and approved item identities
And it executes at least one confined workspace tool
And a cycle with no generated workspace output fails
scenarios.title: The builder starts fresh and must produce workspace output

scenarios.rule: The builder produces a new candidate from the pinned contract
steps: Given the Pi harness ORC worker is running
When Pi requests the executable regeneration workflow contract
Then the builder result includes the field "builderSessionId"
scenarios.title: ORC exposes builder session identity in its executable contract

scenarios.rule: Independent checks determine whether the cycle passes
steps: Given the builder has produced a candidate
When the independent verifier inspects and runs it
Then the candidate must define app and test services
And the app must define a healthcheck without publishing host ports
And every required compose operation and candidate test command must succeed
scenarios.title: Verification rejects an incomplete runnable application contract

scenarios.rule: Independent checks determine whether the cycle passes
steps: Given an approved selection with at least one item
When the independent comparator returns no readable observation
Then the oracle comparison stage fails
And no passing cycle measurement is recorded
scenarios.title: Independent oracle comparison fails closed when no readable verdict exists

scenarios.rule: Independent checks determine whether the cycle passes
steps: Given the approved selection contains three items
And the evidence collector reaches only one item
When the cycle measurement is reduced
Then the measurement total remains three
And each unreached item is recorded as failed and not graded
And the measurement is marked incomplete
scenarios.title: An unreached approved item remains a failed denominator item

scenarios.rule: Independent checks determine whether the cycle passes
steps: Given the oracle comparator, verifier, instrument conformance, and measurement have completed
When the final result is derived
Then it does not pass when any independent gate failed
And every approved item was graded
And failed approved items remain in the denominator
scenarios.title: A final result requires every independent gate to pass

scenarios.rule: Evidence and measurement survive workflow process restarts
steps: Given an observation or cycle measurement has already been recorded
When the exact same identity and content are recorded again
Then the existing durable record is returned
But the same identity with different evidence is refused
scenarios.title: Recording the same evidence twice is idempotent

scenarios.rule: Evidence and measurement survive workflow process restarts
steps: Given a cycle measurement was recorded through its validated command
When the harness restarts against the same event store
Then the complete measurement is reconstructed with the same denominator and verdicts
scenarios.title: A completed measurement is readable after the harness restarts

scenarios.rule: Backend limitations remain explicit
steps: Given a regeneration cycle uses the host backend
When it reaches independent evidence collection and oracle comparison
Then the collector reports that independent comparison requires Gondolin
And the cycle cannot pass as a complete independently graded measurement
scenarios.title: Host execution cannot be reported as independently graded

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the independent baseline judge drives the candidate only through its public seam
When the complete selected denominator passes
Then the cycle evidence contains a non-empty Playwright trace archive
And the normalized evidence proposal binds the trace archive digest
And a missing Playwright trace prevents oracle proposal
scenarios.title: A successful first grade preserves its Playwright trace

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the candidate emits a runtime signal claiming an invariant passed
But no independent validator evaluated the invariant
When the cycle measurement is reduced
Then the candidate signal is retained as evidence
But it cannot produce a passing item observation
scenarios.title: Candidate telemetry cannot author an independent verdict

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the pinned product-oracle OCI contains the approved normalized evidence for an item
And the sealed harness snapshot carries the generic evaluator for the runtime signals declared by the approved project model
And one required signal is missing, incomplete, sampled, or reported as dropped
When the independent validator compares the captured evidence with the product oracle entry
Then it persists an inconclusive invariant evaluation
And the approved item cannot pass the comparison gate
And collection status identifies the affected signal kind and reason
And diagnostic profiles remain available but cannot author a verdict
scenarios.title: Missing or dropped required signals are inconclusive

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given an accepted domain event and every required projection snapshot
And every signal names the same cycle, operation, event, aggregate, and subject digest
When the independent validator evaluates the named product invariant
Then it may record an evidence-backed passing observation
And the observation identifies every input artifact digest
scenarios.title: A passing invariant uses one correlated candidate subject

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the Pi harness ORC worker is running
When Pi requests the executable regeneration workflow contract
Then the observation includes the field "artifacts"
scenarios.title: ORC exposes artifact provenance in its executable contract

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the independent execution emitted runtime evidence
And the black-box oracle comparator returned a failure
When the instrument conformance stage evaluates the runtime evidence
Then it records its own pass, fail, or inconclusive observation
And the behavioral failure cannot skip or author the instrument verdict
And the final cycle passes only when both independent results pass
scenarios.title: Instrument conformance is independent of the behavioral grade

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given each selected item has a runtime evidence contract in the pinned project model
When the instrument conformance stage evaluates the selected items
Then one generic evaluator reads their declared paths, record kinds, cardinalities, correlations, and invariants
And adding a project or item does not require evaluator or ORC source changes
And a selected item with no contract receives a failing observation
scenarios.title: Instrument conformance is selected entirely from the pinned project model

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given an independent invariant evaluation and its evidence digest were persisted
When an OTel result span and Allure report are emitted
Then both identify the persisted evaluation and evidence digest
And both name the same candidate subject and oracle digests
And neither projection can change the recorded verdict
scenarios.title: OTel and Allure project the persisted invariant evaluation

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given an isolated Pi observer session has YOLO tool access inside Gondolin
When the observer profiles the VM while exercising the selected scenario
Then its profile artifacts are recorded as operator-invoked evidence
And the profile cannot become an authoritative grade without deterministic validation
scenarios.title: An operator Pi session profiles a Gondolin VM directly

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the sealed harness snapshot supplies a declarative OTel capture policy
When an independent Gondolin validator room opens for one regeneration cycle
Then the candidate and OTel capture policy are mounted read-only
And the candidate subject digest remains unchanged after observation
And a fresh cycle evidence volume is the only writable grading mount
And the validator image supplies OBI and the OTel eBPF profiler with tracefs and BPF FS mounted
And native OTLP traces, metrics, and profiles are cycle-scoped diagnostic evidence
scenarios.title: Each comparison cycle isolates evidence from its pinned OTel capture policy
